From Fun Fun Fun · Price: a mark must be placed on the limb first.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: mark a limb your stand touches.
  • 5: Surge: move a marked limb (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates): the creature drops an item or falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}.
  • 9: Mark two limbs.
  • 13: Surge: you choose where the creature goes on its next Stride.
  • 17: Surge: control one of its actions (see Defaults).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
